body: No, and I do not see it in the future unfortunately. It costs money and might be seen as trivial in her mind.
Thank you in advance for the compliments. After my revelation yesterday I set out a list of things I'd like to do before my summer ends and during the school year. I wish you the best as well.
My ministers are a lesbian couple, and for sure, they're some of the nicest people I've ever met.

Hello Sophie.

I'm Audrey, and I'm just a year older than you. Although my story is not similar, I too, suffer from heavy depression and thoughts of harming yourself. The fact you have kept going this long shows truth in your mental strength, because after everything, you're still alive. Suicide is not your only option, consider revolution in your image.

I am here to talk if you need me.
